IMPORTANT

RIDER BD IBU EPO 80/50/50 (0/0/0)
AMENDS
BLUE DENTALSM INDIVIDUAL MARKET BENEFITS CERTIFICATE
962F
This rider amends the certificate named above to:
• Explain cost-sharing requirements
• Explain your annual benefit maximum
• Exclude services performed by non-PPO (out-of-network) dentists
This rider is deemed in effect when you or your remitting agent is notified.
© 2025 Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan
A nonprofit corporation and independent licensee of the Blue Cross and Blue Shield Association

This rider changes the coverage in your certificate. Your rider and certificate
are meant to be read together. It is important to review these changes to
understand how your coverage has changed.
Section 2: What You Must Pay
WHAT’S CHANGING?
This rider adds deductible and coinsurance requirements for covered services.
It also explains what your annual benefit maximum is.
Replace the first paragraph of the
Deductible Requirements subsection with the following:
NOTE: THE LANGUAGE IN BOLD IS NEW TO YOUR CERTIFICATE.
Deductible Requirements
The deductible is the amount you must pay for certain covered services
each calendar year before we pay for services.
You must pay the following deductibles for Class II and Class III services
provided by Tier 1 PPO (in-network) dentists:
• $25 for one member
• $50 for two members
• $75 for a family (three or more members)
When the deductible for any one member has been met, we
will pay covered services only for that member until the full
family deductible has been met.
We will not apply payments toward your deductible if one of the following applies:
• The payment is for a charge that exceeds our approved amount.
• The payment is for a non-covered service.
2 © 2025 Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan

Replace the first paragraph of the
Coinsurance Requirements subsection with the following:
NOTE: THE LANGUAGE IN BOLD IS NEW TO YOUR CERTIFICATE.
Coinsurance Requirements
You must pay the following coinsurances for covered services provided by
Tier 1 PPO (in-network) dentists:
• 20% of the approved amount for Class I services
• 50% of the approved amount for Class II services
• 50% of the approved amount for Class III services
Only covered services that are performed by a Tier 1 PPO (in-
network) dentist will be payable by BCBSM.
We will not apply a coinsurance to:
• The difference between our approved amount and the dentist’s charge.
• Non-covered services.
* * * * *
Replace the sentence under the
Annual Benefit Maximum subsection with the following:
NOTE: THE LANGUAGE IN BOLD IS NEW TO YOUR CERTIFICATE.
Annual Benefit Maximum
The annual benefit maximum under this rider is $1,200 per non-pediatric
member, per calendar year. It applies to Class I, II and III dental services
that are provided by Tier 1 PPO (in-network) dentists.
The annual benefit maximum will not apply for pediatric
members.
3 © 2025 Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan

Section 3: Coverage for Dental Services
WHAT’S CHANGING?
This rider excludes services performed by non-PPO (out-of-network) dentists
from coverage.
Add the following bullet under the
Coverage for Dental Services section heading:
NOTE: THE LANGUAGE IN BOLD IS NEW TO YOUR CERTIFICATE.
Section 3: Coverage for Dental Services
This section describes the services we pay for and the extent to which they are
covered. We pay for services when they are provided according to this
certificate and any riders that amend it.
• To be covered, services must be:
− Dentally necessary and
− Performed by a dentist, or, where applicable,
− Performed by a dental hygienist under the supervision of a dentist.
• We do not pay for services provided by non-PPO (out-of-network) dentists.
See Section 4 for any exclusions and limitations.
4 © 2025 Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan

Section 4: Exclusions and Limitations
WHAT’S CHANGING?
This rider excludes services performed by non-PPO (out-of-network) dentists
from coverage.
Add the following bullets under the Exclusions subsection:
NOTE: THE LANGUAGE IN BOLD IS NEW TO YOUR CERTIFICATE.
Exclusions
The following services are not covered under this certificate unless you have a
rider that adds coverage for them. You are responsible for paying the charges
for these services:
• Services provided by non-PPO (out-of-network) dentists
• Services that are covered under medical or drug plans. These services
include hospital, medical and prescription drug benefits. Any surgery that is
usually covered under a medical plan is not covered under this certificate
• Facility or hospital fees that a dentist, physician or hospital charges for
treating a patient in the hospital
5 © 2025 Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan

Section 5: How Dental Benefits Are Paid
WHAT’S CHANGING?
This rider excludes services performed by non-PPO (out-of-network) dentists
from coverage.
Replace the Choosing A Dentist subsection with the following:
NOTE: THE LANGUAGE IN BOLD IS NEW TO YOUR CERTIFICATE.
Choosing A Dentist
Because you are covered under a Blue Dental EPO plan, you must choose a
Blue Dental Tier 1 PPO (in-network) dentist or we will not pay for covered
services.
Our payment will vary based on whether your dentist is a Blue Dental Tier 1
PPO (in-network) dentist or not. If your dentist is a:
• Tier 1 PPO (In-Network) Dentist – We will pay for covered services.
• Tier 2 Participating Non-PPO (Out-of-Network) Dentist – We will not pay
for any services provided by Tier 2 participating non-PPO (out-of-
network) dentists.
• Nonparticipating Dentist – We will not pay for any services provided by
nonparticipating dentists.
Please see the subsection in your certificate titled, “Paying for Services”
for more information about how we pay your dental claims.
6 © 2025 Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan

Replace the Paying For Services subsection with the following:
NOTE: THE LANGUAGE IN BOLD IS NEW TO YOUR CERTIFICATE.
Paying For Services
We pay for covered dental services performed in the state of Michigan.
Because you are covered under a Blue Dental EPO Plan, you must choose a
Blue Dental Tier 1 PPO (in-network) dentist or we will not pay for covered
services.
Below is a description of how we pay for covered services.
• Tier 1 PPO (In-Network) Dentists
Tier 1 PPO (in-network) dentists agree to accept our approved amount
as payment in full for covered services. We pay Tier 1 PPO (in-network)
dentists directly. You are responsible for cost-sharing amounts
required by your plan, as well as any charges for non-covered services.
• Tier 2 Participating Non-PPO (Out-of-Network) Dentists
We will not pay for services provided by Tier 2 participating non-PPO
(out-of-network) dentists.
• Nonparticipating Dentist
We will not pay for services provided by nonparticipating dentists.
7 © 2025 Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan

Section 7: Definitions
WHAT’S CHANGING?
This rider excludes services performed by non-PPO (out-of-network) dentists
from coverage.
Replace the definition of Dentist under the
Definitions section with the following:
NOTE: THE LANGUAGE IN BOLD IS NEW TO YOUR CERTIFICATE.
Dentist
• Tier 1 PPO (In-Network) Dentist
A dentist who has signed a contract to participate in the Preferred
Provider Organization (PPO) network used by BCBSM. Tier 1 PPO (in-
network) dentists agree to accept our approved amount as full payment
for covered services.
Because you are covered under a Blue Dental EPO plan, you must
choose a Blue Dental Tier 1 PPO (in-network) dentist or we will not pay
for covered services.
• Tier 2 Participating Non-PPO (Out-of-Network) Dentist
We will not pay for any services provided by Tier 2 participating non-
PPO (out-of-network) dentists.
• Nonparticipating Dentist
We will not pay for any services provided by nonparticipating dentists.
8 © 2025 Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan

GENERAL
Until further notice, all the provisions in your certificate and in your related
riders are unchanged and in full force and effect, except as stated in this rider.
